verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party export or data-portability feature for Outlook. The Graph API endpoints for reading and syncing messages are developer building blocks, not an export capability. MIME support covers sending mail, not exporting it. The .pst-to-mbox conversion uses a third-party utility (readpst/libpst), which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
